sources.entry: InfiniteCanvas - Proof of concept Mac drawing application.

summary.one_liner: A proof-of-concept Mac drawing app whose vector canvas is meant to be infinite in all three dimensions, growing as you pan and draw.
summary.what_it_does: The README states the goal of a vector-based drawing application where the canvas grows to accommodate strokes as the user pans and draws. It describes unrestricted zooming in and out. The high-level metaphor is "Prezi for drawing instead of presenting." The README does not describe specific tools, menus, file formats, or build steps. It is a short document covering the goal and the MIT license.
use_cases: experimenting with an infinite drawing canvas
studying a Mac drawing app proof of concept
notable: Canvas intended to be infinite in all three dimensions, growing as strokes are added
Presented as a Prezi-like metaphor for drawing
caveats: Described as a proof of concept, not a finished product
README gives no installation or run instructions
README does not name the implementation language or frameworks
